menu.beginText: A scavenger with a suspicious amount of scrap wants a word. Open **Equipment** to hear her out.
menu.resumeText: Patch is still holding your gear. Open **Equipment** to pick up where you left off.

levelUpLabel: 🔧 Equipment training available — check the Waifumon menu.
unavailableText: Patch has packed up her stall for now. Check back later.

intro.title: A Pile of Scrap
intro.narration: A woman surrounded by a suspicious amount of scrap waves you over.
intro.say: Hey. You planning on taking that Buddy anywhere dangerous looking like that?

attack.title: Attack Gear
attack.narration: Patch digs through the pile and produces a length of pipe that has seen better centuries.
attack.say: Nothing fancy. Your Buddy brings the power. This just gives that power somewhere to go.

defense.title: Defense Gear
defense.narration: Patch kicks a bent sheet of metal loose from the heap.
defense.say: Hitting back is great. Not folding in half when something hits first is better.

health.title: Health Gear
health.narration: After another minute of digging, Patch holds up a dented lunchbox.
health.say: Don’t laugh. Surviving longer is a feature.

explain.title: Gear Runs on SP
explain.say: Your Buddy supplies the SP. Gear turns it into something useful.
explain.sayAfter: That’s the whole trick. Better Buddy, better gear, bigger numbers.

noBuddy.title: No Buddy, No Numbers
noBuddy.narration: Patch looks past you, then back at you.
noBuddy.say: Gear’s only as good as whoever’s wearing it. Pick a Buddy from your Collection, then come find me.

complete.title: Equipment Unlocked
complete.say: There. Now you look slightly less doomed.
